host_steps.step: goal 2 the entity's active command descriptor
goal 3 latch the command target on brain+0AF8h
goal 4 resolve the descriptor's handle to an object
goal 5 drop the observer pair on the old object
goal 6 take the observer pair on the new object
goal 7 this side's recon slot
goal 8 does that recon slot hold the target
goal 9 a surface target reopens the gate
goal 10 turn the latched target into a world position
goal 11 refresh the target's world pose
goal 12 carry the stored offset out of the target's frame
path 1 the latched goal becomes a plan
path 2 the plan is asked for the point nearest the pose
path 3 raise the published band's floor to the path width
path 4 publish the lateral-offset bounds for the point
plan 1 hand the goal blk+1DCh to the planner (no plan, both paths idle)
plan 2 hand the goal to the planner (plan not ready)
plan 3 hand the goal to the planner (back path reset)
plan 4 hand the goal to the planner (back path status 0, 2 or 3)
plan 5 advance the plan by the tick delta
distance 1 an attackmove sub-state asks how far the goal is
distance 2 refresh the unit's own pose first
distance 3 the CRT square root
slot 1 the move-on-path step asks whether the slot has legs
